entries.title: Lake Ice Sheet Under Stress
entries.description: A large transparent ice plate floats on pale blue water while a moving heavy sphere presses down and slides, causing branching crack lines to grow, split, and glow briefly as they propagate, with labels showing stress and a meter tracking total crack length.
entries.seed: Lake Ice Sheet Under Stress: A large transparent ice plate floats on pale blue water while a moving heavy sphere presses down and slides, causing branching crack lines to grow, split, and glow briefly as they propagate, with labels showing stress and a meter tracking total crack length.

entries.title: Frozen Pond Thawing From a Central Heater
entries.description: A circular ice disk on top of water has a small warm sphere at its center that pulses heat outward, melting a growing transparent hole while crack patterns radiate, detach chunks that float and rotate, and small water droplets spill and ripple the surface.

entries.title: Footsteps Cracking Thin Ice
entries.description: A human-sized footprint-shaped object repeatedly steps across a thin ice sheet over dark water, each step spawning localized star-shaped cracks that expand, connect with neighbors, and sometimes break free ice fragments that bob and collide, leaving labeled footprints.

entries.title: Iceberg Colliding With a Pier
entries.description: A moving iceberg block slowly drifts into stationary pier pylons, generating sharp fracture planes and chipped-off transparent shards that bounce, rotate, and sink or float, with color-coded stress zones on the iceberg and trails marking the path of broken pieces.

entries.title: Slow-Motion Bullet Through Ice Block
entries.description: A small high-speed sphere passes through a thick ice cube, creating a cylindrical tunnel, conical fracture planes, and radial cracks that grow and branch in slow motion, while tiny particle fragments spray out, bounce on the ground, and fade.

entries.title: Car Tire on Frozen Road
entries.description: A rotating tire rolls along a flat icy road, with friction hotspots appearing as glowing patches where micro-cracks spawn, crawl backward under the tire, merge into larger fractures, and occasionally eject thin slabs that slide aside, leaving a roughened track.

entries.title: Ice Crystals Cracking Under Thermal Shock
entries.description: A cluster of needle-like ice crystals is suddenly hit by a hot air pulse from one side, causing the crystals to bend, snap, and fracture into smaller shards that drift and rotate, with crack paths highlighted and a thermometer bar tracking temperature.

entries.title: Frozen River Breaking During Spring Melt
entries.description: Long ice floes form a cracked sheet over a flowing river; as the water flow increases, large fracture lines open, floes detach, bump, spin, stack, and sometimes reattach at edges, while spray particles rise at collisions and a label shows total moving ice mass.

entries.title: Microscopic View of Crack Propagation in Ice Grain
entries.description: A single translucent ice grain is shown under imaginary “load” from two opposite plates; as the plates slowly move together, an internal crack plane nucleates, branches through the grain in 3D, changes color with stress intensity, and eventually splits the grain.
